event.proposal: Family: feed-forward width. Current retained frontier is 3,488 parameters at 99.630000%, a +0.630000 percentage-point margin over 99%. There have been 6 prior attempts in this family. The most recent accepted result is attempt-0009, ff_dim=8 at 3,488 parameters and 99.63% official accuracy; the most recent failed result is attempt-0010, an optimization failure for ff_dim=4 that ended at 90.65% internal validation without a checkpoint or official score. Hypothesis: the width-capacity transition lies between 4 and 8, and a 6D nonlinear state may retain the carry mechanism while removing 128 parameters. This parameterization-preserving midpoint is more informative than the nearest untested ff_dim=7 because it bisects the measured bracket and maximizes boundary information per full training run. Training schedule and step-20,000 stalled-run gate remain unchanged.
